name: Fennel of Virtue
description: An herb of virtue containing 2 pawns of Vim vis; when Enriched its hardened stalk wielded as a wand drives away evil spirits as a Greater Power.

name: Mistletoe of Virtue
description: Parasitic herb of virtue that, when Enriched by taking root in the wearer's flesh, grants the Supernatural Ability Divination & Augury but also Fragile Constitution; unenriched worth 2 pawns of Intellego vis.

name: Pennyroyal of Virtue
description: Creeping mint-like herb containing 1 pawn of Corpus vis, known as Heal-All; when Enriched it confers a Greater Purifying Touch against an ailment determined by the ruling star.

name: Periwinkle of Virtue
description: Blue flower of virtue that when Enriched grants Venus's Blessing along with the Reckless Flaw; unenriched worth 1 pawn of Mentem vis.

name: Centaury of Virtue
description: Herb of Virtue listed with a +3 Flight shape and material bonus.

name: Cinquefoil of Virtue
description: Herb of Virtue listed with shape and material bonuses of +3 Leadership and +1 Rego Mentem.

name: Herbs of Virtue
description: Plants that naturally contain vis and can be Enriched into charms that grant Virtues or powers.

name: Objects of Virtue
description: Natural objects such as gems and formed stones that contain vis and can be Enriched to confer Virtues; rarely useful to magi due to zero Penetration and the Warping they cause.

name: Enrichment
description: The process of treating a Thing of Virtue (herb, object, tree) through a ritual procedure, usually over a season, so it confers a Virtue or power instead of being harvested for vis.

name: Shape and Material Bonuses
description: Bonuses associated with materials and shapes, used as inspiration for deriving the Virtues of Objects of Virtue.

name: St. Michael
description: Saint on whose sacred day fennel of virtue must be plucked to be Enriched.

name: Divination & Augury
description: Supernatural Ability granted by an Enriched Mistletoe of Virtue, using a unique method of consuming its berries for visions.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Flaw imposed on the host of an Enriched Mistletoe of Virtue; also a Flaw of the falcon.

name: Continent
description: Flaw whose restriction the owner of Enriched Fennel of Virtue must observe, or its power fades.

name: Venus's Blessing
description: Virtue granted by an Enriched Periwinkle of Virtue.

name: Reckless
description: Flaw conferring impetuousness, granted by the Periwinkle of Virtue garland; also a Flaw of hounds.

name: Amethyst of Virtue
description: Gem containing 1 pawn of Mentem vis that, when Enriched, confers Lesser Immunity to drunkenness while touching the drinker's skin.

name: Bloodstone of Virtue
description: Stone containing 1 pawn of Creo vis that, when Enriched, grants Rapid Convalescence while the bearer rests in bed.

name: Bufonite of Virtue
description: A Toad Stone containing 2 pawns of Intellego vis that, when Enriched, has a Lesser Power to detect poison by turning red.

name: Toad of Virtue
description: Toad from whose living head the Bufonite of Virtue must be removed for Enrichment.

name: Opal of Virtue
description: Gem containing 2 pawns of Terram vis that when Enriched provides the Sure Traveler Virtue along with a minor Personality Flaw.

name: Sapphire of Virtue
description: Gem containing 1 pawn of Intellego vis that can be Enriched by full moonlight to confer the Intuition Virtue.

name: Clam Shell of Virtue
description: Shell containing 1 pawn of Terram vis that, Enriched under a waterfall, confers the Tough Virtue.

name: Emerald of Virtue
description: Gem containing 2 pawns of Animal vis that, Enriched in a snake's nest, grants Animal Ken restricted to serpents.

name: Jet of Virtue
description: Jet containing 1 pawn of Perdo vis that when Enriched grants Puissant Stealth, lost if anyone but the owner sees it.

name: Topaz of Virtue
description: Gem containing 1 pawn of Mentem vis that when Enriched grants Puissant Leadership.

name: Formed Stones
description: Shaped stones, called lusus naturae, said to be formed by vis plastica, astral conjunctions or other causes; many are Objects of Virtue.

name: Vis Plastica
description: Creative force said by some to form shaped stones in the soil.

name: Vis Formativa
description: Force from astral conjunctions said to fertilize soil and rocks to produce formed stones.

name: Clach Crubain of Virtue
description: Bent formed stone containing 1 pawn of Perdo vis that when Enriched with oil confers Lesser Immunity to arthritis.

name: Ovum Anguinum of Virtue
description: Serpent's Egg formed stone containing 2 pawns of Creo vis that confers Improved Characteristics (Stamina), Improved Communication, or Tough depending on Enrichment.

name: Thunderbolt of Virtue
description: Pointed stone that falls in thunderstorms, containing 1 pawn of Auram vis; Enriched it wards against Demons of the Air as a Greater Power.

name: Demons of the Air
description: Class of demons warded off by an Enriched Thunderbolt of Virtue.

name: Cornu Ammonis of Virtue
description: Horn of Ammon, a coiled stone with 2 pawns of Intellego vis that, Enriched, grants prophetic dream Visions to one sleeping on it.

name: Glossopetrae of Virtue
description: Stone Adder's Tongue containing 1 pawn of Aquam vis, Enriched to be an antidote to liquid poisons.

name: Fairy Loaves of Virtue
description: Flat bun-shaped formed stones containing 1 pawn of Muto vis each; Enriched, they keep milk fresh as a Lesser Power.

name: Pliny the Elder
description: Classical author cited on the Cornu Ammonis, bears, boars, bulls, cats, lions and wolves.

name: Lesser Immunity
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue conferred by several Objects of Virtue, e.g. against drunkenness, arthritis or lightning.

name: Rapid Convalescence
description: Minor General Virtue granted by an Enriched Bloodstone of Virtue.

name: Sure Traveler
description: Minor Heroic Virtue provided by an Enriched Opal of Virtue.

name: Intuition
description: Minor General Virtue conferred by an Enriched Sapphire of Virtue.

name: Tough
description: Minor General Virtue giving +3 Soak, conferred by the Clam Shell or Ovum Anguinum of Virtue and possessed by many beasts and elementals.

name: Animal Ken
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granted, for serpents only, by an Enriched Emerald of Virtue.

name: Puissant Stealth
description: Minor General Virtue granted by Enriched Jet of Virtue.

name: Puissant Leadership
description: Minor General Virtue granted by an Enriched Topaz of Virtue.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Minor General Virtue conferred by Ovum Anguinum of Virtue and common among beasts.

name: Visions
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw given by an Enriched Cornu Ammonis to one who sleeps on it.

name: Hex
description: Virtue (from Realms of Power: Infernal) whose curse power is granted, aligned with Magic, by Blackthorn of Virtue thorns.

name: Dowsing
description: Virtue provided by a wand Enriched from a Hazel Tree of Virtue.

name: Premonitions
description: Virtue/Ability granted by an Enriched mandrake root, whose writhing foretells the future.

name: Puissant Art
description: Virtue that can be conferred by Enriching a vis-bearing item giving a Shape and Material bonus to a specific Art.

name: Magic Thing
description: Inherited Virtue of magical beings that are things rather than creatures, such as the mandrake, Amiculum, kelpies and elementals.

name: Ways of the (Land)
description: Virtue representing an elemental's intuitive understanding of the environment that spawned it, e.g. Ways of the Cavern, River, Storm, Forest Fire.

name: Poor Memory
description: Inherited Flaw of all elementals.

name: Short Attention Span
description: Inherited Flaw of all elementals.

name: Simple-Minded
description: Inherited Flaw of all elementals, as they are neither alive nor truly sentient.

name: Magical Friend
description: Virtue possessed by the awakened cloak Amiculum.

name: True Friend
description: Virtue possessed by the awakened cloak Amiculum.

name: Magical Monster
description: Flaw possessed by the kelpie.

name: Ferocity
description: Minor beast-only Virtue granting Confidence points usable when the beast's natural ferocity is triggered.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: Virtue possessed by kelpies, adders and some fire elementals, prompting reflexive attacks.

name: Berserk
description: Virtue possessed by the wild boar and the sample earth elemental.

name: Great Stamina
description: Minor Virtue possessed by the sample earth elemental.

name: Shapeshifter
description: Major Virtue of the sample air elemental letting it adopt forms of creatures it has seen.

name: Keen Vision
description: Minor Virtue of the sample air elemental and falcons.

name: Puissant Hunt
description: Minor Virtue of the sample water elemental.

name: Infamous
description: Flaw of adders and wolves.

name: Greedy
description: Minor Flaw of bears and boars.

name: Reclusive
description: Flaw of the bear.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: Virtue of the wild boar.

name: Wrathful
description: Minor Flaw of the wild boar.

name: Affinity with Brawl
description: Virtue of the bull, reflecting how quickly it learns to fight.

name: Oversensitive
description: Flaw of the bull (to provocation).

name: Perfect Balance
description: Virtue of the cat, granting bonuses to climbing and jumping.

name: Puissant Awareness
description: Virtue of the cat.

name: Sharp Ears
description: Virtue of cats, hounds and wolves.

name: Nocturnal
description: Flaw of the cat.

name: Fear
description: Flaw of the courser horse (loud noises).

name: Long-Winded
description: Virtue of horses, hounds and wolves giving bonuses to endurance rolls.

name: Noncombatant
description: Flaw of the courser and palfrey.

name: Proud
description: Flaw of the destrier, charger and lion.

name: Puissant Brawl
description: Virtue of the lion.

name: Self-Confident
description: Virtue of the lion.

name: Weakness
description: Flaw of the lion (submission).

name: Higher Purpose
description: Virtue of the stag (protect the herd).

name: Compulsion
description: Flaw of the wolf (killing), reflecting its medieval perception as a bloodthirsty killer.

name: Lesser Magic Power
description: Virtue granted by the Rowan of Virtue amulet, equivalent to a Rego Vim ward.

name: Clumsy
description: Flaw of an animated tree.

name: Restricted Power
description: Flaw of the Mandrake Root of Virtue.

name: Weak Characteristics
description: Flaw of the Mandrake Root of Virtue.

name: Arcane Lore
description: Virtue of the Mandrake Root of Virtue.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Minor Virtue and Ability possessed by Amiculum.

name: Awakened Trees
description: Trees in Magic auras that are aware and capable of limited movement; at aura 6+ they are fully awake, having Cunning but no Might.

name: Animated Tree
description: A tree made mobile by spells such as Lord of the Trees or by a spirit's Manifestation power; has no Might unless animated by Manifestation.

name: Trees of Virtue
description: Usually awake trees with no Might containing 1-3 pawns of vis, which can be Enriched into charms granting Virtues.

name: Blackthorn of Virtue
description: Tree whose 13 Enriched thorns grant a Magic-aligned Hex power usable once each; may instead be harvested for 2 pawns of Perdo vis.

name: Hazel Tree of Virtue
description: Tree with a symmetrical forked branch that can be Enriched into a Dowsing wand; contains 1 pawn of Intellego vis.

name: Oak of Virtue
description: Oak whose heartwood, containing 2 pawns of Auram vis, can be Enriched to grant Lesser Immunity to lightning.

name: Rowan of Virtue
description: Tree from which an Enriched protective amulet grants a ward against creatures of one supernatural Realm for seven years.

name: Mandrake Root of Virtue
description: Magic Thing root with Might 5 whose deadly scream kills those who hear it; may be Enriched to grant Premonitions or bonded as a homunculus familiar.

name: Deadly Scream
description: Greater Power of the mandrake root, deadly to all who hear it when pulled from the soil.

name: Stir the Slumbering Tree
description: Spell (ArM5 p.137) whose description notes most trees in Magic auras are awake.

name: Lord of the Trees
description: Hermetic spell that animates a tree; its combat statistics match those of an animated tree.

name: Calling the Council of the Trees
description: Hermetic spell that can animate trees.

name: Freeing the Striding Tree
description: Spell treated as equivalent to Manifestation for letting an animated tree uproot and move.

name: Crafter of Herbam
description: Common non-Hermetic power of nature spirits that can animate trees.

name: Manifestation
description: Spirit power by which a spirit inhabits and animates a tree, giving it temporary Might.

name: War for the Woods
description: Story seed in which a covenant overharvests vis from a magical forest and awakened trees and forest spirits retaliate.

name: The Mandrake's Scream
description: Story seed about a nobleman's son killed by a mandrake's scream at a hangman's tree.

name: Florae
description: Forest spirits that may protect a forest by animating its trees.

name: Genius Loci
description: Spirit of place that may protect a forest by animating trees.

name: Airy Spirits
description: Spirits that often attend Trees of Virtue.

name: Homunculus
description: A mandrake root bonded by a hedge wizard like a familiar, looking like a six-inch little man.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Non-Hermetic magician who may Enrich mandrake roots or bond them as homunculi.

name: Awakened Items
description: Magical devices that become magic things through lab accidents or exposure to the Magic Realm.

name: Amiculum
description: An awakened white woolen cloak and former talisman of a Hermetic magus that returned from his Twilight as an independent magical being with Magic Might 5.

name: Cloak of the Duck's Feathers
description: Aquam effect held by Amiculum as a constant Lesser Power.

name: Whiten the Wear of Travel
description: Amiculum's Lesser Power that removes dirt and mends small tears in the cloak.

name: The Woolen Cloud
description: Amiculum's Lesser Power letting it float and carry up to two people.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's personal enchanted item; Amiculum was its master's talisman.

name: Twilight
description: State into which Amiculum's master went, from which the talisman returned as an independent being.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic protection that Amiculum's powers need not penetrate to affect its master.

name: Kelpie
description: Carnivorous magical creature (Might 20 Aquam) of deep fresh-water pools, a mass of tentacles that can turn into a black stallion to lure and drown victims.

name: Equine Metamorphosis
description: Kelpie power transforming it into a black stallion.

name: Equine Charisma
description: Kelpie power making itself alluring to victims.

name: Fleet of Foot
description: Kelpie power letting it travel three times a normal horse's speed in stallion form.

name: To Break a Kelpie
description: Story seed in which a Highland clan chief commissions a magical bridle to capture a kelpie, risking breach of the Peripheral Code.

name: Scottish Highlands
description: Region whose clans figure in the kelpie story seed.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Hermetic legal code; aiding a chieftain might breach it as interference with mundanes.

name: Elementals
description: Magic Things composed of pure elemental matter that rarefy under magical impetus; not alive, ageless and without thought.

name: Rarefication
description: Process by which raw elemental matter takes on pseudo-life and self-organizes into an elemental.

name: Atoms
description: Four varieties of uncuttable building blocks of the universe (earth, water, air, fire), each with two qualities.

name: Corpuscles
description: Building blocks of matter with shape: cubes for earth, icosahedra for water, octahedra for air, tetrahedra for fire.

name: Lunar Sphere
description: Region beyond the region of fire separating the material and celestial realms.

name: Rarefy the Crude Water
description: Creo Aquam 30 Ritual spell creating a water elemental from a pool of water.

name: Command the Living Fire
description: Rego Ignem 20 spell to control a fire elemental of up to Size 0.

name: Words of the Flickering Flame
description: Spell used to understand an elemental's communication.

name: Voice of the Lake
description: Spell used to understand an elemental's communication.

name: Incantation of Lightning
description: Spell which cast in a Magic aura can rarefy an elemental, per a story seed.

name: The Forgotten Child
description: Story seed where a magus unwittingly rarefies an elemental.

name: The Unforgiving Sea
description: Story seed about a magus trapped by a water elemental grown too powerful.

name: Lunchtime in the Vis Stores
description: Story seed about a dormant earth elemental consuming a covenant's Terram vis.

name: Temporary Might
description: Magical Inferiority of all elementals making Might recovery difficult; broken-off pieces contain vis.

name: No Fatigue
description: Magical Quality possessed by elementals and animated trees.

name: Earth Elemental
description: Genomi: territorial, patient elementals of unworked earth, strong and fast, that crush prey and thirst for moisture.

name: Water Elemental
description: Lymphae: elementals of naturally occurring water, resilient and slow, that collect substances and drown opponents.

name: Air Elemental
description: Zephyrus: restless, highly perceptive elementals of open air and weather, including wind, cloud and lightning elementals.

name: Fire Elemental
description: Phlegethi: elementals of naturally occurring flame that desire to burn and can beguile onlookers.

name: Crush
description: Obligatory Greater Power of earth elementals, a clubbing attack that can pin and damage equipment.

name: The Red Touch
description: Earth elemental power rusting metal to dust.

name: Slake Thirst
description: Earth elemental power drawing water from targets.

name: Drown
description: Obligatory Greater Power of water elementals, engulfing and drowning targets.

name: Chill Touch
description: Water elemental power extracting heat for +10 damage.

name: Sight of the River
description: Water elemental power to view any location connected by water.

name: Crafter of Water
description: Power duplicating Creo or Rego Aquam spells of level 15 or below.

name: Suffocate
description: Obligatory Greater Power of air elementals, entering a victim's lungs.

name: Dissolution
description: Air elemental power making matter lose cohesion and melt.

name: Jupiter's Touch
description: Air elemental power causing lightning for +30 damage.

name: Charge of the Angry Winds
description: Spell mimicked as a power by the sample air elemental.

name: Burn
description: Obligatory Greater Power of fire elementals, damaging and igniting what touches them.

name: Fascination
description: Fire elemental power entrancing those who see its flames.

name: Heat of the Searing Forge
description: Creo Ignem spell mimicked as a fire elemental power.

name: Enliven the Gross Fire
description: Ritual power letting a fire elemental spawn more fire elementals.

name: Salamander
description: Beast of Virtue not to be confused with fire elementals called salamanders.

name: Art & Academe
description: Supplement referenced for more details on elemental physics.

name: Mundane Beasts
description: Beasts of Mythic Europe with no Might and no vis, using Cunning instead of Intelligence.

name: Beast Qualities
description: Features of animals affecting capabilities, from Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults.

name: Adder
description: Venomous small snake common in Mythic Europe except Ireland, with a Venomous Bite.

name: Bear
description: Brown bear, a large shaggy beast of forests and mountains, ferocious when wounded.

name: Wild Boar
description: Tusked forest beast of evil temper called la bête noire, hunted by noblemen.

name: Bull
description: Spanish-type bull easily provoked, fought by Moorish nobles and used in bull-baiting.

name: Cat
description: Domestic cat with a reputation for evil among common folk, keen-eyed and agile.

name: European Wildcat
description: Wild cat with thicker shaggy coat and bushy tail.

name: Falcon
description: Gyrfalcon, swiftest of birds, used by nobles to hunt game birds.

name: Courser
description: Swift light horse like the Andalusian used for hunting and travel, not trained for battle.

name: Charger
description: Light horse trained for battle, derived from the courser.

name: Palfrey
description: Gentle-gaited riding horse, often for ladies or inexperienced riders.

name: Destrier
description: Heavy war horse such as the Percheron, trained to charge and fight.

name: Hound
description: Large hunting dog such as the bloodhound, loyal and keen-scented.

name: Lion
description: Legendary fierce beast said by Pliny to have lived in Greece; will not attack a prostrate man.

name: Stag
description: Red deer, favorite quarry of hunters, which flees to protect its herd.

name: Wolf
description: Feared bloodthirsty pack predator found throughout Mythic Europe.

name: Venomous Bite
description: Adder power inflicting adder venom if its Attack Advantage exceeds armor Protection.

name: Master of the Pack
description: Human who leads a pack of dogs as a trained group using Animal Handling.

name: Charles Martel
description: Historical figure (8th century) since whose time destriers have been bred.

name: Confidence
description: Points that beasts with Ferocity may spend in battle under certain circumstances.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The game setting whose beasts and nature are described.

name: Ireland
description: Land where the adder is not found.

name: Pyrenees
description: Wilderness area where bears are common.

name: Alps
description: Wilderness area where bears are common.

name: Scandinavia
description: Northern land where bears and gyrfalcons live.

name: Russia
description: Land where bears and gyrfalcons live.

name: Iceland
description: Cold northern land home to gyrfalcons.

name: Spain
description: Land where Moorish nobles fight bulls from horseback.

name: England
description: Land where the cat's bad reputation is unknown.

name: Achelous
description: River in Greece bounding the lion's European range per Pliny.

name: Mestus
description: River in Greece bounding the lion's European range per Pliny.

name: North Africa
description: Region where lions and wolves live.

name: Syria
description: Region lions inhabited per Pliny.

name: India
description: Land where Pliny writes of magical bulls.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form; Fennel of Virtue contains Vim vis.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique; several Objects of Virtue contain Intellego vis.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form; Pennyroyal of Virtue and mandrake contain Corpus vis.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form; Periwinkle, Amethyst and Topaz of Virtue contain Mentem vis.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique; Ritual Creo spells can create elementals.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form of earth, governing earth elementals.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form; Emerald of Virtue and Amiculum carry Animal vis.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique; Perdo spells can destroy elementals' matter.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form of air, governing air elementals.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form of water, governing water elementals and kelpies.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique; Fairy Loaves contain Muto vis.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique used to control elementals.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire, governing fire elementals.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form of plants; trees may yield Herbam vis.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form used in kelpie and water elemental powers.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power measured in pawns, found in Things of Virtue, trees and elementals.

name: Magic Aura
description: Aura of the Magic Realm in which things are superior examples of their kind and elementals can form.

name: Faerie Aura
description: Aura visited in the Enrichment of Fairy Loaves.

name: Dominion
description: Divine aura; mandrakes grow beneath hangman's trees outside it.

name: Warping
description: Magical effect caused by Objects of Virtue; Warped raw matter may rarefy into an elemental.

name: Might
description: Measure of supernatural power; awakened trees have none while elementals' Size depends on it.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance possessed independently by a kelpie mount.

name: Greater Power
description: Class of magical power used by many Things of Virtue and creatures.

name: Lesser Power
description: Class of magical power used by Things of Virtue and creatures.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link needed to curse a victim with Blackthorn of Virtue thorns.

name: Familiar
description: Bonded animal of a Hermetic magus; mandrake homunculi are used similarly.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of magi, which knows spells catalyzing rarefication and names elementals.

name: Magical Qualities and Inferiorities
description: Purchased features of magic characters; elementals' Characteristics are bought with matching Qualities and Inferiorities.

name: Magic Realm
description: The supernatural Realm to which Things of Virtue, elementals and Blackthorn's Hex are aligned.

name: Infernal Realm
description: Supernatural Realm; Fennel of Virtue weakens creatures of Infernal Might.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Supernatural Realm; the Rowan amulet can ward against its creatures.

name: Divine Realm
description: Realm which the Rowan of Virtue amulet cannot ward against.

name: Hermetic Magus
description: Member of the Order of Hermes; Amiculum's master was one.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House; more than one Flambeau magus has accidentally rarefied a fire elemental.

name: Covenant
description: Home of magi, whose vis stores and nearby forests feature in story seeds.

name: Brawl
description: Ability used by animated trees, elementals and beasts for natural attacks.

name: Athletics
description: Ability all elementals must have at a score equal to their Might magnitude.

name: Swim
description: Ability water elementals use instead of Athletics.

name: Penetration
description: Ability for getting powers past Magic Resistance.

name: Ride
description: Ability used to ride a trained kelpie.

name: Awareness
description: Ability commonly possessed by elementals and beasts.

name: Hunt
description: Ability possessed by kelpies, elementals and beasts.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability often possessed by elementals.

name: Stealth
description: Ability of kelpies, earth elementals and predators.

name: Survival
description: Ability of Amiculum and many beasts.

name: Charm
description: Ability of kelpies and fire elementals.

name: Latin
description: Language Amiculum understands.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Ability possessed by Amiculum.

name: Leadership
description: Ability of the wolf pack leader.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability a Master of the Pack uses to command dogs.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability possessed by Amiculum.

name: Legerdemain
description: Ability possessed by Amiculum.

name: Concentration
description: Ability possessed by Amiculum.
